Callout.Name: Grow Operation - Warrant
Callout.Message: Warrant for an address with a suspected grow.
Callout.Advisory: Hum from the property, windows covered.

Script.Line: The humming is a fan. It is a big house.
Nobody is in the back of the house and nobody has been for a week.
You have got the warrant. You do not need a conversation.

Stages.Stage: Nobody is answering the front door.
Somebody has gone out of the back and into the field.
Property searched and the plant seized.

Lines.Approach: Humming, covered windows, and a meter nobody has been able to read. The warrant is signed.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
